description: Merge one tag into another: every contact carrying tagId gets targetTagId instead, then tagId is deleted. This cannot be undone. No sequences start. Returns the kept tag and contactsUpdated. A merged tag on more than 20,000 contacts returns status processing instead: the contacts move within minutes and the merged tag is deleted last, during which other renames, merges and deletes are refused (409 tag_in_progress; list_tags shows changeInProgress). Refused (409, with a usage list) while a sequence, segment, campaign, email, sync rule, goal, integration, form, popup or landing page still uses the merged tag. System tags cannot be merged. The API key needs tags:write and tags:delete.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

tagId.description: ID of the tag to merge away and delete. Use list_tags to find tag IDs.

targetTagId.description: ID of the tag to keep.

name: merge_tags

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `merge_tags` MCP tool.

contactsUpdated.description: Contacts moved from the merged tag to the kept tag. Present only when status is completed.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

status.description: completed, or processing when the merged tag is on more than 20,000 contacts and they are still being moved.

tag.description: The tag record returned by Sequenzy.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
